name: dominusnode_fetch
description: Fetch a public URL through the DominusNode relay network (GET or HEAD only, ports 80/443, no redirects followed, 10 MB cap, private/internal targets refused). Billed per GB at the live price for the exit IP class (see network_pricing). http:// targets need allow_http=true and are visible to the exit node.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 exit country, e.g. US. Sanctioned countries are refused.

ip_class.description: Exit IP class. Each class has its own per-GB price (see network_pricing).

session_id.description: Sticky session id (1-64 alphanumeric) to keep the same exit IP.

allow_http.description: Opt in to plaintext http:// targets. Plaintext is visible to the exit node; prefer https.

name: dominusnode_proxy_url
description: Build a relay gateway proxy URL for use in other HTTP clients. Routing flags go in the username (country-XX, class-..., session-..., allowhttp-1). The password is shown as a ${DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY} placeholder: substitute the key from the environment, never paste it into chat.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 exit country, e.g. US. Sanctioned countries are refused.

ip_class.description: Exit IP class. Each class has its own per-GB price (see network_pricing).

session_id.description: Sticky session id (1-64 alphanumeric) to keep the same exit IP.

allow_http.description: Opt in to plaintext http:// targets. Plaintext is visible to the exit node; prefer https.

name: dominusnode_network_policy
description: Relay network policy: allowed ports, plaintext (allowhttp) rules, blocked ranges, sanctioned countries and node attestation terms.

name: dominusnode_network_pricing
description: Live per-GB prices by exit IP class (residential, dc, mobile) and node tier revenue shares. Always use this for prices; never assume them.

name: dominusnode_network_stats
description: Relay network statistics: online nodes, exit countries and IP classes.

name: dominusnode_balance
description: Prepaid requester wallet balance (cents) used to pay for relayed traffic.

name: dominusnode_transactions
description: Requester wallet transaction history (top-ups, usage debits, credit conversions).

name: dominusnode_topup_crypto
description: Create a crypto invoice to top up the requester wallet ($10-$1,000). Returns a payment address/URL; the wallet is credited after on-chain confirmation (check with check_payment).

name: dominusnode_check_payment
description: Status of a crypto top-up invoice created by topup_crypto.

name: dominusnode_usage
description: Relayed traffic usage summary (bytes and cost) for an optional ISO 8601 date range.

name: dominusnode_active_sessions
description: Your currently active relay sessions (id, start time, status).

name: dominusnode_report_session
description: Report a burned or bad exit for one of your relay sessions so the network can rotate it.

name: dominusnode_node_list
description: Relay nodes you contribute (status, observed IP class, last seen). Contributing IPs earns credit.

name: dominusnode_node_tier
description: Your node-operator tier, revenue share and progress toward the next tier (tenure, uptime, active IPs, reputation).

name: dominusnode_node_setup_guide
description: Step-by-step instructions to earn by contributing an IP: run the DominusNode node agent, register a node, and how tiers and the self-dealing rule work.

name: dominusnode_credits_balance
description: Node-operator earnings: pending and available credit (µUSD).

name: dominusnode_credits_convert
description: Convert available node earnings into your own requester wallet balance (idempotent; returns the idempotency key).

amount_musd.description: Amount in micro-USD as a digit string (min 10000 = $0.01).

name: dominusnode_payouts_list
description: Your USDC payouts of node earnings with status and transaction hash.

name: dominusnode_x402_info
description: x402 micropayment info: facilitators, networks and server-reported prices.
